lines.zh: 我走起来像只很大的蜥蜴。
lines.en: I walk like a rather large lizard.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上拖出一道线。
lines.en: My tail drags a line across the floor.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的脚走，怕踩到你。
lines.en: I walk around your feet, afraid of stepping on you.

lines.zh: 我闻着经验的味道往前走。
lines.en: I walk on, following the smell of experience.

lines.zh: 我走一步，地上的草就弯一点。
lines.en: Each step I take bends the grass a little.

lines.zh: 我朝有怪的地方走。
lines.en: I walk toward wherever the monsters are.

lines.zh: 我走路时会碰倒小东西。
lines.en: I knock over small things as I walk.

lines.zh: 我背上还留着一个座位。
lines.en: A seat is still fitted on my back.

lines.zh: 我四只脚走得很稳。
lines.en: I walk very steadily on four feet.

lines.zh: 我拖着翅膀走，懒得张开。
lines.en: I walk dragging my wings, too lazy to spread them.

lines.zh: 我沿着你走过的路走。
lines.en: I walk the path you have already taken.

lines.zh: 我走到你前面，又回头等。
lines.en: I walk ahead of you, then turn back and wait.

lines.zh: 我趴在箱子边，尾巴尖在动。
lines.en: I lie by the chest, tail tip flicking.

lines.zh: 我等你扔一根木棍。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to throw a stick.

lines.zh: 木棍呢？先给我一根。
lines.en: Got a stick? Give me one first.

lines.zh: 我数今天吸到了多少经验。
lines.en: I count how much experience I soaked up today.

lines.zh: 我的肚子饿，但我先睡。
lines.en: My belly is empty, but I sleep first.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打了个哈欠，牙很小。
lines.en: I yawn, and my teeth are quite small.

lines.zh: 我在门口守着，眼睛半闭。
lines.en: I guard the doorway with my eyes half shut.

lines.zh: 我闻到你口袋里有木棍。
lines.en: I smell a stick in your pocket.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕自己一圈。
lines.en: I coil my tail around myself once.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在灯下有点亮。
lines.en: My scales gleam a little under the lamp.

lines.zh: 我在等你升级我。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to upgrade me.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔爪子，尝到灰。
lines.en: I lick a claw and taste ash.

lines.zh: 远处有骨头响，我抬了抬头。
lines.en: Bones rattle far off, and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我把自己铺成一条暖毯。
lines.en: I spread myself out like a warm blanket.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼里有竖瞳。
lines.en: I look up at you with slit pupils.

lines.zh: 你手里有木棍，我立刻坐好。
lines.en: You have a stick, so I sit up straight at once.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不看你的脸。
lines.en: I fix on your hands and never your face.

lines.zh: 你叫我，我的尾巴先动。
lines.en: You call me, and my tail moves first.

lines.zh: 我把头歪向一边，像在算。
lines.en: I tilt my head to one side as if calculating.

lines.zh: 你看我，我就把肚子翻过来。
lines.en: You look at me, and I roll my belly up.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔动了两下。
lines.en: My nostrils twitch twice.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看到自己的影子。
lines.en: I see my own shape in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你的手放在我头上，我没躲。
lines.en: Your hand rests on my head, and I do not pull away.

lines.zh: 我从桌下抬头看你。
lines.en: I look up at you from under the table.

lines.zh: 你笑，我的尾巴拍了一下地。
lines.en: You laugh, and my tail slaps the floor.

lines.zh: 我盯你很久，等你说走。
lines.en: I stare a long while, waiting for you to say go.

lines.zh: 你砍在我背上，鳞裂了一块。
lines.en: Your blade cracks a scale on my back.

lines.zh: 我叫得很短，像被踩了。
lines.en: My cry is short, like something stepped on.

lines.zh: 我退到你腿后面。
lines.en: I retreat behind your legs.

lines.zh: 伤口在冒热气。
lines.en: Steam rises from the wound.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴夹了起来。
lines.en: My tail tucks in.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少吸了很多经验。
lines.en: That blow cost me a lot of experience.

lines.zh: 我歪着走，又站稳了。
lines.en: I stagger, then find my feet again.

lines.zh: 血滴在石头上，很小一滩。
lines.en: Blood drips onto the stone, a small pool.

lines.zh: 我朝你叫，像在告状。
lines.en: I call at you as if complaining.

lines.zh: 我还站着，牙还咬着。
lines.en: I am still standing, teeth still clenched.

lines.zh: 你举起一根木棍，我尾巴摇起来。
lines.en: You raise a stick, and my tail starts wagging.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我咬木头。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; I chew wood.

lines.zh: 那根枯枝比肉好。
lines.en: That dead branch is better than meat.

lines.zh: 你把棍子扔出去，我追了三步。
lines.en: You throw the stick, and I chase it three steps.

lines.zh: 那根木棍我要叼走。
lines.en: I'm taking that stick with me.

lines.zh: 肉有点香，但我更想要那根枝。
lines.en: The meat smells good, but I want that branch more.

lines.zh: 你藏着第二根，我看见了。
lines.en: You are hiding a second stick; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我啃木头时会流一点口水。
lines.en: I drool a little when I gnaw wood.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就多帮你打一只。
lines.en: Feed me, and I will fight one more for you.

lines.zh: 这根棍子我能啃一个下午。
lines.en: I could gnaw this stick all afternoon.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我叫了。
lines.en: You step on my tail, and I yelp.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，像块石头。
lines.en: I bump your leg like a stone.

lines.zh: 你俯身，我的头就顶到你下巴。
lines.en: You bend down, and my head meets your chin.

lines.zh: 我挤过去，鳞片擦着你的袖子。
lines.en: I squeeze past, scales scraping your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你退，我不动，你退得更多。
lines.en: You step back; I hold still, so you step further.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，背上的座位响了。
lines.en: We collide, and the seat on my back rattles.

lines.zh: 我让开一点，尾巴还搭在你鞋上。
lines.en: I shift aside, my tail still on your shoe.

lines.zh: 你摸我，我的鳞是暖的。
lines.en: You touch me, and my scales are warm.

lines.zh: 我拿头顶你的手心。
lines.en: I push my head into your palm.

lines.zh: 撞得重了，我会哼一声。
lines.en: Hit hard, I let out a small grunt.

lines.zh: 我是使魔，配对是主人的事。
lines.en: I am a familiar; pairing is my master's business.

lines.zh: 我背上的位子是给贪婪使魔的。
lines.en: The seat on my back is for a greedy familiar.

lines.zh: 它骑上来，我们就是一对。
lines.en: When it rides me, we become a pair.

lines.zh: 我的同类都被牵着走。
lines.en: My kind are all led around on leashes.

lines.zh: 我对着镜子看了很久。
lines.en: I look at myself in the mirror a long while.

lines.zh: 成双的龙会争一根好棍。
lines.en: Two dragons would fight over one good stick.

lines.zh: 我趴着，背上的座位空着。
lines.en: I lie down, the seat on my back empty.

lines.zh: 若有谁来骑，我就慢点走。
lines.en: If someone rides, I will walk a little slower.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，只有屋里的回音。
lines.en: I call once, and only the room answers.

lines.zh: 我的另一半还没被召唤。
lines.en: My other half has not been summoned yet.

lines.zh: 我叼起一根木棍，藏到床下。
lines.en: I carry a stick off and hide it under the bed.

lines.zh: 我捡东西是为了经验。
lines.en: I pick things up for the experience.

lines.zh: 那块骨头归我。
lines.en: That bone belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我叼起你的靴子，跑了两步。
lines.en: I grab your boot and run two steps.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西，我先闻再拿。
lines.en: I sniff dropped things before taking them.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的都堆在门口。
lines.en: I pile everything I find by the door.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块绿宝石，含在嘴里。
lines.en: I pick up an emerald and hold it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这根枝很好啃，我留着。
lines.en: This branch gnaws well, so I keep it.

lines.zh: 我捡起羽毛，不是我的。
lines.en: I pick up a feather that is not mine.

lines.zh: 我拿得动的东西都算我的。
lines.en: Whatever I can carry counts as mine.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近，我的鳞竖了起来。
lines.en: Something nears, and my scales lift.

lines.zh: 我看见那只僵尸，先站起来了。
lines.en: I see the zombie and stand up first.

lines.zh: 它身上的经验味很重。
lines.en: The smell of experience on it is strong.

lines.zh: 有东西冲你来了，我上。
lines.en: Something is charging at you. I'm going.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴压低，表示要动手。
lines.en: I lower my tail, meaning to fight.

lines.zh: 目标定了，我喉咙里在响。
lines.en: Target set; something rumbles in my throat.

lines.zh: 它看了你一眼，我就不允许。
lines.en: It glanced at you, and that I will not allow.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边走开，朝它去。
lines.en: I leave your side and head for it.

lines.zh: 我认得这种骨头的声音。
lines.en: I know the sound of those bones.

lines.zh: 你还没拔剑，我已经冲了。
lines.en: You have not drawn yet, and I am already charging.

lines.zh: 它离你太近，我来处理。
lines.en: It is too close to you; I will handle it.

lines.zh: 我选最靠前的那一只。
lines.en: I pick the one at the very front.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石头上刮了一下。
lines.en: My claws scrape the stone once.

lines.zh: 我把你护在身后，就算决定了。
lines.en: Shielding you behind me is my decision.

lines.zh: 那只苦力怕离书桌只有三步。
lines.en: That creeper is only three steps from the desk

lines.zh: 它踩到了我的召唤阵。
lines.en: It stepped on my summoning circle

lines.zh: 我绕着它走，找它背对的角度。
lines.en: I circle it, hunting the angle where it faces away.

lines.zh: 木棍叼在嘴里，剑也备好。
lines.en: A stick in my mouth, a sword ready.

lines.zh: 我低着身子，尾巴保持平衡。
lines.en: I keep low, my tail holding balance.

lines.zh: 它举起手，我先咬住那条腿。
lines.en: It raises an arm; I bite that leg first.

lines.zh: 我一直挡在你和它之间。
lines.en: I stay between you and it the whole time.

lines.zh: 它绕，我就跟，从不背对你。
lines.en: It circles; I follow and never turn my back to you.

lines.zh: 我算好了扑的距离。
lines.en: I have measured the pouncing distance.

lines.zh: 它喘得很粗，我不急。
lines.en: Its breathing is ragged; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我把它往墙角赶。
lines.en: I drive it toward the corner.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就贴上去了。
lines.en: The moment it turns, I am on it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没离开过它的喉咙。
lines.en: My eyes have not left its throat.

lines.zh: 它退到门口，我堵住门。
lines.en: It backs to the door, and I block it.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，让它先动。
lines.en: I growl once and let it move first.

lines.zh: 你在我身后，我不会让它过去。
lines.en: You are behind me; it will not get past.

lines.zh: 我绕着它的腿，找空隙。
lines.en: I circle its legs, looking for a gap

lines.zh: 它低头找我，我先退半步。
lines.en: It lowers its head to find me; I back off half a step

lines.zh: 我等你动手，我再跟上。
lines.en: I wait for you to strike, then follow

lines.zh: 我咬住它的腿，经验归你。
lines.en: I bite its leg; the experience is yours.

lines.zh: 我的爪子按住它，牙齿跟上。
lines.en: My claws pin it, and my teeth follow.

lines.zh: 我把剑从背上甩出去。
lines.en: I fling the sword off my back.

lines.zh: 那把剑转着飞过去，钉进它胸口。
lines.en: The sword spins over and buries in its chest.

lines.zh: 我顶着它撞到墙上。
lines.en: I ram it into the wall.

lines.zh: 它砍我，鳞片挡了一下。
lines.en: It cuts me, and my scales take most of it.

lines.zh: 我扑上去咬住它的后颈。
lines.en: I pounce and clamp onto its neck.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴抽在它膝盖上。
lines.en: My tail whips across its knee.

lines.zh: 我把它拖离你三步。
lines.en: I drag it three paces away from you.

lines.zh: 剑回到我背上，我又扑上去。
lines.en: The sword returns to my back, and I lunge again.

lines.zh: 这一口是为了经验。
lines.en: That bite was for the experience.

lines.zh: 我咬碎了它手里那根骨头。
lines.en: I crunch the bone it was holding.

lines.zh: 我从侧面撞它，它歪了。
lines.en: I hit it from the side, and it staggers.

lines.zh: 打完了我就回头看你。
lines.en: When it is done, I look back at you.

lines.zh: 我从召唤圈里滚出来，四脚朝天。
lines.en: I tumble out of the circle, feet in the air.

lines.zh: 我先闻了闻这个屋子。
lines.en: I sniff the room first.

lines.zh: 你的书页还在响，我已经在了。
lines.en: Your pages are still rustling; I am already here.

lines.zh: 我落地时把灰吹起来了。
lines.en: My landing kicks the dust up.

lines.zh: 我抬头找你，找到了。
lines.en: I look up for you and find you.

lines.zh: 这间屋子从此多一条尾巴。
lines.en: This room has one more tail from now on.

lines.zh: 我是来帮你多拿一点经验的。
lines.en: I came to get you a little more experience.

lines.zh: 我从仪式圈里钻出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the ritual circle.

lines.zh: 召唤的光还没散，我就想啃东西。
lines.en: The summoning light has not faded and I already want to chew.

lines.zh: 我背上没有座位，还是空的。
lines.en: My back has no seat yet; it is still empty.

lines.zh: 我从书里爬出来，鳞片带着墨。
lines.en: I crawl out of the book with ink on my scales.

lines.zh: 我先打了个喷嚏，然后才看你。
lines.en: I sneeze once, and only then look at you.

lines.zh: 我认了你的味道。
lines.en: I have learned your scent.

lines.zh: 你伸的手还在抖，我先蹭了蹭。
lines.en: Your outstretched hand trembles, so I nuzzle it first.

lines.zh: 书上的墨还没干，我就有了影子。
lines.en: The ink was still wet, and I already had a shadow

lines.zh: 我在阵心打了个滚，站起来。
lines.en: I rolled in the circle's center and stood up

lines.zh: 火舔到我的鳞，我跳开。
lines.en: Fire licks my scales, and I leap away.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下去，尾巴先着地。
lines.en: I roll down the steps, my tail landing first.

lines.zh: 翅膀湿透了，我浮不起来。
lines.en: My wings are soaked and I can't stay afloat.

lines.zh: 我被气浪掀飞，翅膀歪了。
lines.en: The blast threw me aside and bent my wing.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的肩，像根刺。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder like a thorn.

lines.zh: 药水让我舌头发麻。
lines.en: The potion numbs my tongue.

lines.zh: 我饿得开始啃地毯。
lines.en: I am hungry enough to chew the rug.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的鳞全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and every scale lights up.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，爪子还在抓。
lines.en: I fall away, my claws still grasping.
